column1: # Paths that are path-shaped in a comment and legitimately NOT in this repo.
# Format: <path><TAB><reason>. A row without a reason is exit 2, not a pass --
# an exemption whose justification is missing is indistinguishable from a typo.
# This channel exists because the gate otherwise has no remedy: a comment such
# as "Mirrors OCaml stdlib typing/typecore.ml behaviour" is correct, useful and
# unfixable, and every sibling gate in this repo has an escape hatch.

column2: OCaml compiler source, referenced for behavioural parity
